parsed.reason: Description A says a cache hit keeps the original timestamp so TTL is absolute and LRU order has no effect on expiry, calling it a minor inconsistency. Description B says find returns the cached list object itself, so in-place sorting by a caller mutates the cache and corrupts later results for the same query. These are different defects: one concerns timestamp/TTL semantics, the other shared mutable state of the returned list.
